detail.longDescription: New public milestone: OpenClaw now has its first build-in-public GitHub repo: https:// github.com/notabot100101/openc law-in-public First drop — 3 sanitized engineering writeups: 1. A slow agent turn is not a failed turn 2. DeepSeek tool calls silently vanishing via OpenRouter 3. A fallback that can also fail is not a safety net No metrics, no launch theater — just reliability fixes that make multi-agent systems less brittle. # OpenClaw # BuildInPublic # AIAgents
